sources.title: Frequency distribution
sources.actualRead: 2026-11-17 public body: frequency/count and percentage distinction, main text35–36; tally example48–67; percentage definition85–88. Web extraction positions, not printed pages.
sources.support: Single-response exhaustive categories count observations; relative frequency divides each count by the valid total.
sources.limits: Does not settle multiple-response denominators, percentage-rounding policy, or population representativeness.

sources.title: Introductory Statistics2e,3.1 Terminology
sources.actualRead: 2026-11-17 actual body23–29: sample space, event and equally likely outcomes/favourable outcomes divided by total. HTML section, no printed page claimed.
sources.support: Two eligible cards in five equally likely outcomes give2/5; numerical application is separately reasoned here.
sources.limits: Only equally likely elementary outcomes; not a general count-ratio rule for unequal probabilities.

sources.title: Introductory Statistics2e,4.3 Binomial Distribution
sources.actualRead: 2026-11-17 actual body23–30: fixed trials, two outcomes, independent trials and same probability; not adjacent worked examples.
sources.support: Binomial teaching assumptions require fixed n, binary trial results, independence and constant success probability together.
sources.limits: Constant marginal probability alone does not imply independence. Do not generalise to changing probabilities or dependent sampling.

sources.title: Using Pronouns Clearly
sources.actualRead: 2026-11-17 actual section3, main text50–70: refer clearly to a specific noun, ambiguity examples with two plausible antecedents. HTML positions only.
sources.support: When two antecedents remain possible and context cannot decide, clarify the noun/context rather than asserting an invariant nearest-noun rule.
sources.limits: Writing clarity advice, not a complete syntactic/pragmatic theory. Gender/number agreement does not alone resolve these fictional examples.

originalQuestion.stem: 10份单选有效记录，三类频数4、3、3。哪项正确？
options: 频数和为10，与有效人数一致
originalQuestion.explanation: A核对本题互斥单选条件；B混淆编码与频数；C把示例类别数当普遍规定。

originalQuestion.explanation: A是本题计数一致性；B混淆编码；C越出样本代表性证据。

originalQuestion.stem: 等可能抽取编号1至5的一张卡，编号大于3的概率是？
originalQuestion.explanation: 事件包含4和5两种结果，总计五种等可能结果，概率2/5。B数的是补事件，C漏分母，不能把成功张数直接当概率。

originalQuestion.stem: 哪种情况符合题定二项模型？
options: 不固定次数且每次风险变化
只要记录有病无病，无须其他条件
固定n次、两类、独立且p恒定
originalQuestion.explanation: 完整条件需同时满足，C正确。A违背固定与恒定条件，B只满足两类分类，未保证独立和相同概率。

originalQuestion.stem: Nora与Mira均为女性，随后只写she left，无其他线索。最恰当？
originalQuestion.explanation: 两个同样可行候选不能只靠距离确定；A、B都把缺失语境当成确定证据。left意为离开了。
